scope: Governed board Task and same-board subtask creation using host-reserved IDs, shared BusinessObjectRef/ActionRequest/ActionRun and ApprovalGate, native confirmation, parent/board/column CAS, atomic task/revision/activity/Run and explicit no-replay recovery
source_state: Selected uncommitted workspace snapshot. Batches 15-23 have not been committed, pushed or released. Includes inherited board regression sources and read-only runtime dependencies. Concurrent CLI/IDE/goal/RRSI changes preserved without adopting their implementation work. No session-core implementation changes. Source bytes captured after tests and checked for stability throughout finalization.

native.adapter: Native SQLite engines through synchronous production-interface test wrappers

sqlcipher.reason: No production SQLCipher encryption or multiple-ciphers packaging acceptance performed

review.work: Implemented creator preview/native execution/history recovery, parent source refresh, store and page compatibility and epoch fences; independently reviewed host-reserved IDs, creation source/parent versions, current authorization, native gate and final task/board/parent/activity/Run postconditions

governed_creation.renderer_input: boardId, UUIDv4 idempotencyKey and whitelisted taskData; actual task ID generated in main process
governed_creation.fixed_fields: status=open, task_type=task or subtask from parent presence, reporter_did=current authenticated actor; no labels/sprint/custom initial status or type/attribution payload support
governed_creation.source: Current board/column snapshot and monotonic structure revision, preallocated absent task ID with no canonical/task/tombstone collision, optional same-board parent full source version and acyclic bounded parent chain; same-organization active assignee rechecked before and after native confirmation and writes
governed_creation.admission: Metadata-only queued standard Run persists host task ID and source/parent hashes before native confirmation; process-local 5-minute wall/monotonic capability binds actor, generation, trusted sender/frame, window and database object/file/context; running persisted before shared strict/high ApprovalGate default-cancel dialog
atomic_success: standard succeeded Run plus source/approval/sqlite-board-task-create evidence
governed_creation.final_postconditions: Exact full new row, board/column snapshot, parent version, activity and receipt rechecked before top-level IMMEDIATE transaction commit
governed_creation.recovery: Same request never repeats running/unknown/terminal mutation or native dialog. Restart loses queued capability. Board-wide pending creation fence prevents another nonce or new reserved ID bypassing unknown creation; independent unresolvedRun remains visible beyond history pagination
governed_creation.quotas: All queued/cancelled/unknown creation records count; vault Run and live preview quotas are shared with field editing/movement; no automatic record pruning
governed_creation.storage: Existing durable native SQLite top-level synchronous IMMEDIATE transactions, safe journal/synchronous, foreign keys and exact nine-trigger profile with unexpected persistent/TEMP triggers rejected
governed_creation.privacy: Persistent Run and activity omit task title/description and original nonce; IDs, source/parent versions, decisions and execution metadata retained. Authorized preview context remains transient memory without a physical erasure guarantee
governed_creation.compatibility: Canonical task:create-task request branch remains on its independent project authorization. Ordinary board payloads and create-subtask plus raw manager create methods reject direct writes. Existing task editor metadata history recognizes creation Runs
governed_creation.renderer: Creator owns reviewable preview and explicit native execution, source and optional parent refresh, no replay, history/cancel and late-result/auth/identity/vault/board fences. Store only uses scoped create APIs and fresh task/list after succeeded; page modal epoch protects close/reopen and late refresh

tests_overlap: Native engine groups overlap and are not added; renderer and notification groups include inherited cases.
native_creation_crash_scenarios: new task/revision/activity/success Run written before commit
crash_recovery: Actual child SIGKILL, native reopen integrity_check=ok, atomic existence of task/revision/activity/succeeded Run, separate process resends serialized request with zero dialogs and no insertion replay
inherited_crash_scenarios: Eight field/movement crash cases rerun alongside four new creation cases
boundaries: Initial status open and task/subtask creation only; labels, sprint placement, other initial types/statuses and multirole assignment roster not migrated
Fine per-object ACL, organization multilevel approvals, other board actions, canonical task adjuncts and other object/goal actions remain pending
Native window/dialog/auth are injected in tests; no actual Electron GUI journey, production SQLCipher encryption, power loss or arbitrary multiprocess competition acceptance
Source bounds, unexpected trigger profile, nondurable adapters and exhausted quotas fail closed; no automatic record cleanup or implicit legacy data repair
Queued previews reserve only ledger identity, not a business task; abandoned queued records still consume the documented hard quota
Summary HTTP substitute does not prove real Ollama inference or summary quality
Cloud policy, native whole-vault transfer, exact-commit cross-platform release matrix, publication and external business acceptance remain pending
